news.title: Savannah Bananas hit home run at Kinnick Stadium
news.summary_en: Over the Fourth of July weekend, the Savannah Bananas rolled into town for two unforgettable sold-out Banana Ball games, transforming Kinnick Stadium into a baseball field unlike anything fans had ever seen.
